g.text: CHORUS and TECE atom-count scaling on RTX 4090
Strict FP32 (TF32 disabled) · ~18 directed neighbors/atom · graph construction excluded
Median of 5–15 timed calls after 3 warm-ups. Periodic jittered carbon; 5 Å cutoff. CHORUS uses atom-count-specific MakeFX buckets.
